nodes.text:
🛑Symptoms of HMPV  Similar to other respiratory viruses:
Fever
Cough
Nasal congestion
Shortness of breath  Severe cases can lead to bronchitis or pneumonia.

nodes.author: UpscRepublicX
nodes.text:
🛑Transmission
 HMPV spreads through:
Close contact with infected persons
Respiratory droplets (sneezing, coughing)
Contaminated surfaces
It thrives in colder months, much like the flu.

nodes.author: UpscRepublicX
nodes.text:
🛑Treatment
 No specific antiviral treatment or vaccine exists for HMPV. Care focuses on symptom management, such as rest, hydration, and medications for fever or congestion.

🛑Discovery: Identified in 2001 by Dutch scientists.

Nature: A respiratory virus belonging to the Paramyxoviridae family.

Affects the respiratory tract of humans.
